exposure: T4 mandibular invaded oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
tumor characteristics (location on tongue, pathological N2-3 stage, peri-neural invasion, lymphovascular invasion, extra-nodal extension)
outcome: length of tumor spreading along the inferior alveolar nerve (IAN)
IAN invasion in tumor-invaded mandibular marrow
cohort: The study participants were 28 T4 pathological oral squamous cell carcinoma specimens that involved the mandible.
finding: The length of tumor spreading along the inferior alveolar nerve was 3 to 12 mm, leading to a recommendation for a mandibular resected margin of at least 18 mm as a clear surgical margin in cases of T4 mandibular invasion OSCC.
followup_time: N/A (survival was analyzed, but no specific follow-up duration is mentioned)
